appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.subtitle: Themes are synced across all projects.
appearance.themeHint: Can be changed on the fly

compiler.title: LaTeX compiler
compiler.subtitle: latexmk runs the selected engine inside the container until references and the table of contents converge.
compiler.passesHint: Latexmk reruns the engine until .aux/.toc converge — this is the upper bound for a pathological convergence loop.
compiler.concurrencyHint: Each build runs in its own texlive container. “Build all” queues the extra builds so the machine isn't overloaded. The default is picked for this machine — from its core count and memory.

checks.title: Document checks
checks.subtitle: GOST standards and guidelines are enabled automatically based on the document type (TZ, VKR, etc.). Manage them in the «Checks» tab of an open document.
checks.perDocumentHint: For a document: open it → «Checks» tab → use the «Ignore» button on a specific rule.

fonts.title: Fonts
fonts.subtitle: Fonts used to build PDFs. Upload your own TTF/OTF (e.g. Times New Roman, Consolas) or download free ones from the catalog — they are mounted into the compile container.
fonts.info: By default PDFs are built with free look-alikes (Tinos, DejaVu). To make glyphs match the originals (Times New Roman, Consolas), upload their files here. Rebuild the document after adding or removing fonts.
fonts.empty: No fonts uploaded yet — builds use free look-alikes.
fonts.catalogHint: Free fonts with Cyrillic support. Downloaded into the local folder and immediately available to the compiler.
fonts.marketplaceHint: Search free fonts with Cyrillic support. Only fonts with static weights (required by XeLaTeX) are listed. Installed ones appear above.
fonts.marketplaceEmpty: Nothing found. Try a different query or filters.
fonts.systemHint: Fonts installed on your machine — the app found them itself. Tick the ones you need and copy them into the working folder.
fonts.systemUnavailable: Could not look into your system font directory.
fonts.uploadDropHint: or click to choose. TTF, OTF and TTC are supported.
fonts.uploadWrongType: Only TTF, OTF or TTC font files are accepted.
fonts.systemUnavailableHint: Usually this means Docker is not responding or has no access to the system drive. Until then, upload font files yourself or take free ones from the catalogue.

images.title: Docker and images
images.subtitle: Choose which TeX Live image to use for builds. You can keep several versions and switch between them.
images.updateTitle: Run docker pull to update layers
images.removeActiveDisabledTitle: Cannot remove the active image — pick another one first
images.fetchTagsError: Could not fetch the tag list from Docker Hub. Check your internet connection or try again later.
images.dockerUnavailableDetail: Start Docker Desktop or install it from docker.com — without Docker, LaTeX builds are impossible.
images.dockerPermissionTitle: No access to the Docker socket
images.dockerPermissionHint: Docker is running, but the app has no permission on its socket — so no document will build. The app runs as an unprivileged user and needs the socket's owning group.
images.dockerPermissionSteps: Add this line to the .env next to docker-compose.yml and restart the container:
images.activeImageNotInstalled: The image is not installed locally — builds will refuse to start.
images.noInstalled: No locally installed images. Install at least one from the list below.

languageTool.title: LanguageTool
languageTool.subtitle: Grammar, spelling and style. The image starts automatically in Docker during checks (on a free port) and stops itself after idling — no need to enable it or specify an address. You can keep several versions and switch between them.
languageTool.updateTitle: Run docker pull to update layers
languageTool.removeActiveDisabledTitle: Cannot remove the active image — pick another one first
languageTool.fetchTagsError: Could not fetch the tag list from Docker Hub. Check your internet connection or try again later.
languageTool.willStartAutomatically: Will start automatically on the next check
languageTool.dockerUnavailableDetail: Start Docker Desktop — without it LanguageTool checks are unavailable.
languageTool.activeImageNotInstalled: The image is not installed — LanguageTool checks are skipped until you download it.
languageTool.noInstalled: No locally installed LanguageTool images. Install a version from the list below.

officeServices.title: Presentations
officeServices.subtitle: Docker services for working with presentations: the PDF-preview converter and the slides editor. Install an image once — the container starts automatically when needed and stops itself after idling.
officeServices.convertSub: Converts .pptx to PDF on build — for the inline presentation preview in the "Preview" tab.
officeServices.editorSub: Full .pptx editing right in the app, in the "Slides" tab.
officeServices.statusError: Could not fetch the service status. Make sure the backend and Docker are running.
officeServices.convertNotInstalled: The image is not installed — presentation PDF previews are skipped until you download it.
officeServices.editorNotInstalled: The image is not installed — the "Slides" tab won't open the editor until you download it.
officeServices.makeActiveTitle: Use this image for the service
officeServices.updateTitle: Run docker pull to update layers
officeServices.fetchTagsError: Could not fetch the tag list from Docker Hub. Check your internet connection or try again later.
officeServices.noInstalled: No locally installed images. Install a version from the list below.

providers.title: Providers
providers.subtitle: External AI providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, OpenAI-compatible) and the default provider for agents. Keys are stored locally and never passed to the browser. Local models are on the adjacent tab.
providers.empty: No providers configured. Add the first one to connect AI agents.

agentPersonas.title: Agent roles
agentPersonas.subtitle: Roles set the tone and focus of the assistant in chat. Built-in roles can be duplicated and edited; your roles are stored locally, alongside providers.
agentPersonas.noCustomRoles: No custom roles yet. Create a role or duplicate a built-in one.

signing.title: Signing certificates
signing.subtitle: Local identities for cryptographic PDF signing (PAdES). Assign them to slots in the project «Signatures» panel. Self-signed certificates need no external CA but carry no legal force outside your environment.
signing.deleteConfirm: Remove the identity «{{label}}»? The key will be permanently destroyed.
signing.loading: No saved identities. Create a self-signed one or import a .p12.

disk.title: Disk
disk.subtitle: How much disk space the app's Docker resources use — images, containers, volumes, cache — and what's safe to free up. Other software's containers and images are neither shown nor touched.
disk.dockerUnavailable: Docker is unavailable — couldn't measure disk usage.
disk.cleanAllDescription: Only the items listed below will be removed. Active images, running containers and other software's data are left untouched; removed images re-download when needed.
disk.cleanAllNothing: Nothing to remove — everything is already clean.
disk.volumesHint: Volumes are never deleted: they hold the TeX Live cache and downloaded models — losing them makes the next build noticeably slower.
disk.removeImageConfirm: Remove image {{image}}? It will re-download when needed.
disk.removeContainerTitle: Remove stopped container (recreated on next use)
disk.imageInUseTitle: Image is used by a container
disk.imageActiveTitle: The active image of its category — protected from removal
disk.containerRunningTitle: Container is running — it stops by itself when idle
disk.warnThresholdHint: When reclaimable space passes this threshold, the app offers to clean up Docker on launch.

about.description: A local tool for writing and formatting HSE academic papers. Programme-specific requirements come from a template pack. Runs on top of the file system — no databases or cloud services.
about.configFolderHint: Global settings, providers and chat history
about.autoUpdateHint: Checked every few hours. An update never starts during a build or an assistant turn, and a failed one rolls itself back.
about.autoUpdateUnsupported: This run mode cannot replace the app itself — update manually.
